answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a stake that thaws like a glacier: only a thin slice unlocks per epoch, so a fresh identity cannot vote or earn at full weight for weeks. Reputation accrues the way a pearl forms, layer by layer, from attested work, never bought in bulk. A sparrow-weight identity spawning a thousand clones still pays one full stake per clone and waits the same thaw each time, so a Sybil farm cost scales linearly while its influence stays capped at the slowest layer.
